hand.title: Daily Hand

events.text: Your cards — 7, 8. Your opponent raised before the cards were dealt. You called.
Flop — Queen, Queen, 5. Your opponent bet. You called.
River — 4. Your opponent fired a large river bet.

wrongReasons: 6 K is close, but the river lead is the tell. The correct hand picked up more on the river than 6 K would have.
9 4 makes a full house here — a hand that strong would have raised earlier and pushed harder for maximum value. The measured sizing in this hand points to something weaker.
A 9 is close, but the river lead is the tell. The correct hand picked up more on the river than A 9 would have.
hand.explanation:
Answer: J 2

Your opponent flopped two pair and bet all three streets with growing sizing. The consistent pressure — especially the larger turn bet — signals a hand strong enough to protect but not quite a monster.
